_comment: SPEC-057 §Structure cross-language sanitizer-parity fixture — input->expected pairs for the branch-segment sanitizer. The sanitizer exists in TWO hand-maintained forms: assets/hooks/session-start-resume.mjs:138-142 (inline regex chain, derives an actor slug from a linked worktree's branch name) and packages/core/src/seat.ts (TS `sanitizeBranchSegment`, used by `seatBranchName` to build `plan/<sanitized-slug>`). Both MUST produce byte-identical output for every pair below — divergence between the two hand-maintained copies breaks a test here, not production (SPEC-057 Structure section rationale). The rule both implement: lowercase, collapse every run of characters outside [a-z0-9-] to a single '-', then strip leading/trailing '-'. Every `input` value is also a LEGAL git branch name (no leading '-', no '..', no trailing '.', no spaces) so the hook suite can create a real `git worktree add -b <input>` fixture from it.
